question: What event at the time of bodily dissolution marks the culminating moment described?
premises: The moment of bodily fall is specified.
The skull is said to be pierced then.
inference: At the fall of the body, the skull is pierced at that moment.
uncertainties: The fused form kapālambhidyate is read as kapālam bhidyate.
plain_english: O Goddess, when the body falls, then the skull is pierced.
